name: 燃地灼烧·踏入
description: 任何角色移动到志志雄真実释放我流·炎灵所点燃的格子时，失去自身当前生命值50%的真实伤害。
skillCode: var shishio = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.templateId === 'red-shishio' && p.ownerPlayerId === context.playerId && p.currentHp > 0; }); if (!shishio) return { success: false, message: '' }; var exts = battle.extensions; var burnTiles = exts && exts.shishioBurnTiles; if (!burnTiles || burnTiles.length === 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var mover = context.sourcePiece; if (!mover || mover.currentHp <= 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var onTile = burnTiles.some(function(t) { return t.x === mover.x && t.y === mover.y; }); if (!onTile) return { success: false, message: '' }; var dmg = Math.ceil(mover.currentHp * 0.5); dealDamage(shishio, mover, dmg, 'true', battle, 'shishio-burn-move'); return { success: true, message: mover.name + ' 踏入燃地！承受 ' + dmg + ' 点真实伤害（当前生命值50%）' };
